scope: Local PHP + SQL-backed upstream. No external WhatsApp delivery.
checks: Old localStorage auth does not grant access
Invalid contact file cannot advance or create campaign
Create + multipart XLSX import + duplicate click protection
Launch queues messages; pause/resume/stop reflect backend
Backend deletion confirmation, cancel, deletion and list refresh
Malformed backend response retains shell and recoverable error
Invalid UUID, missing CSRF and cross-origin rejected server-side
Password change invalidates both existing sessions
Old password rejected; new password works
No browser secrets/direct n8n requests and no uncaught runtime errors
